coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary high-value miss-class recall only. Production nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative.
All 12 targeted search requests completed and returned results. No verified new eligible U.S. food-access disruption was found in the observation window.

Results included stale articles about earlier grocery-store losses and emergency-food cancellations, notably July 2026 Avondale, Cincinnati full-service grocery closure; September 2026 Eastport, Maine grocery loss; July 2026 eastern Michigan mobile distribution cancellations. These were not newly reported within this window.
SNAP/WIC query results were dominated by October–November 2025 federal shutdown impacts, not new 2026 official interruptions. Excluded as old information.

Search crawl/fetch date is not publication time. No same-hour source publication was inferred from a recent crawl timestamp; no positive finding was added without independently supported timing and immediate access consequences.

The conservative one-day query recency is a retrieval filter, not proof that underlying articles were published today. Search indexing and social-media notice visibility limit sensitivity, but no material tool failure occurred.
Excluded duplicates, donation drives, routine outreach, guides, general inflation/food-price commentary, opinion, and promotional content.
